We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the case: Using aluminum-containing leavening agent (baking powder) in food, exceeding safety standards. This is production/sale of food not meeting safety standards. The label list includes: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". Also possibly "生产、销售伪劣产品" but that is for substandard products, but the specific label for food safety is the one. The facts: knowingly used prohibited additive, resulting in high aluminum residue. So charge: 生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品.

Check if any other charge applies: maybe "生产、销售有毒、有害食品"? Aluminum is not necessarily toxic? The label "生产、销售有毒、有害食品" is for toxic/harmful foods. The case is about exceeding safety standard for aluminum additive, which is a safety standard violation, not necessarily toxic. The training examples: earlier example about "生产、销售有毒、有害食品" involved sildenafil (a drug) in health product. So here it's about food safety standard. So answer single charge.

Thus final answer: [罪名]生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品<eoa>
